facts.claim: Linear is a product for software teams that focuses on issue tracking, project planning, and product roadmaps.
facts.excerpt: Linear empowers software teams to build better products. It streamlines issue tracking, project planning, and product roadmaps.
facts.source_title: Linear Integrations | Connect Your Apps with Notion

facts.claim: Linear links can be previewed inside Notion with real-time previews of issues, views, and projects.
facts.excerpt: you can bring the magic of Linear to Notion. When you paste links from Linear, you’ll be able to see real-time previews of your issues, views, and projects directly in Notion.
facts.source_title: Linear Integrations | Connect Your Apps with Notion

facts.claim: Linear’s Notion AI connector lets users search Linear projects, issues, and comments from Notion.
facts.excerpt: Search Linear projects, issues, and comments from Notion.

facts.claim: The Notion AI Connector is available for all Linear organizations.
Linear’s Notion connection shows live previews for issues, projects, and views, including issue title, description, status, issue ID, team, assignee, and last update date.
facts.excerpt: For issues, the preview shows issue title, description, status, issue ID, team, assignee, and the date of the last update.

facts.claim: Linear’s Notion integration updates previews when the underlying Linear data changes.
facts.excerpt: Once any of these properties change in Linear, the preview in Notion changes accordingly (on page reload or manual preview refresh).
